origin.description: Centers and scales columns with the weighted moments.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A data matrix, one observation per row.

arguments.name: w
arguments.text: One weight per row. Omitted means equal weights that sum to 1.

arguments.name: center
arguments.text: Subtract the weighted means. The default is true.

arguments.name: scale
arguments.text: Divide by the weighted standard deviations. The default is true.

origin.details: A zero scale is replaced by zero after the division, and a warning counts those columns. The center and scale are kept on the result.
origin.value: A matrix of the same shape.
